profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | AI Platforms, RAG, Agentic Workflows | Python, Kubernetes, Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer (via Itility US)
positions.description:
* Architected, developed, and deployed a scalable application hosting platform to support diverse software scripts written in various programming languages, including Python and MATLAB, as containerized microservices.

* Aided multiple teams in migrating legacy code to a Kubernetes-based hosting platform, including designing solutions for seamless integration of data consumption and generation workflows.

* Worked within the AI Enablement team to assist ML Engineers in deploying and hosting machine learning models on a Kubernetes platform.

* Designed and implemented robust ETL pipelines to transform on-premise raw data into optimized time-series parquet files, enabling seamless consumption by other teams and supporting the development of insightful KPIs.

* Developed monitoring applications for real-time KPI tracking on both on-premise infrastructure and Azure cloud solutions.

* Aided in the seamless migration of an application from on-premise infrastructure to Azure Cloud, enhancing scalability, performance, and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · REST APIs · Kubernetes · Azure Databricks · Python · FastAPI · Flask · PySpark · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · MLflow · Scikit-Learn · Azure DevOps · Azure App · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Helm (Software) · Terraform · Microservices

positions.title: Lead Data Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer building AI platforms, developer tooling, and cloud-native infrastructure supporting engineering productivity. Focus areas include agentic workflows, RAG/GraphRAG knowledge systems, MCP integrations, Azure Kubernetes platforms, and operator-facing React/TypeScript interfaces.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Full Stack Developer on some of the following projects:
 * Internal applications for the IT department using WPF following a MVVM pattern. 
 * Develop and deploy applications as services
 * Develop applications to test Web APIs
 * Develop image processing algorithms using OpenCV with C# and Python
 * Develop an image processing library using Emgu.CV
